entries.land_location_as_stated: End of #10 Rd; surrounded by hundreds of other acres of forest in central Maine
entries.description: Two lesbians and one daughter living on 30 chemical-free acres of forest in central Maine with animals, growing much of their own food. Lesbians may camp for as long as they like if self-sufficient; monthly full moon celebrations open to all lesbians. Welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women. Has housing, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods and farmland being cleared.
entries.raw_text: GATHERING GROUND c/o Linda & Carol, RFD 2, Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172 (End of #10 Rd). We are two (sometimes more) lesbians living on 30 acres surrounded by hundreds of other acres of forest in central Maine. We are chemical free. We share space with Carol's 11-year-old daughter, 3 horses, 10 chickens, 3 ducks, 6 cats and 1 dog. We grow much of our own food. Lesbians are welcome to camp on our land whenever and for as long as they like. They must be self-sufficient and carry all trash out and leave camping space as they found it. We have full moon celebrations on Sat evening closest to full moon every month - all lesbians welcome to share/join us. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 nonlesbian, 30 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, slowly clearing farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: rural route address (RFD 2) taken as the land. Type: Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('We are two (sometimes more) lesbians'); camping guests do not change it. num_residents 3 from 'We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 nonlesbian' with 'women living and working on the land'; the 1 nonlesbian is likely Carol's 11-year-old daughter (a member's child, counted). Acreage 30 is their own; the 'hundreds of other acres of forest' that surround them are not counted. Accepted: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory, lesbians live there); Girl children and Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women'. Focuses: Environmentalism from 'We are chemical free'; Farming from 'We grow much of our own food'; Spirituality from 'full moon celebrations ... every month'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: tucked away in the woods of Central Maine
entries.description: A sanctuary for women, plants and animals: one lesbian homesteading since 1981 on 10 wooded acres in central Maine, carrying water, growing and preserving her food, making cheese from goats, heating with firewood. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children and possibly non-lesbian women. Has 2 structures, camping space, woods and farmland.
entries.raw_text: CHRIS OF COVENTREE PO Box 16, Troy, ME 04987. A sanctuary for women, plants, animals. I started homesteading on a ten acre piece of land tucked away in the woods of Central Maine summer of '81. Doe goats, cats, a dog and sometimes other lesbians have shared this homeland with me. I carry my water, plant and preserve the food I grow in my garden and the cheese I make, heat with firewood I mostly cut myself, build with scrap lumber. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (maybe). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 10 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: PO box is not the land; land_state ME from 'woods of Central Maine', no land town given. contact_name left blank because mail goes to the community name 'Chris of Coventree' (Chris is presumably the owner). Type: Private/Individual Land, one woman ('I have/am: 1 lesbian'); 'I welcome: new members/residents' is a checked questionnaire item rather than active recruiting, so kept as Private/Individual Land. num_residents 1 from '1 lesbian' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women; Girl children; Non-lesbian women conditional '(maybe)'. Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency from 'homesteading', 'plant and preserve the food I grow'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Located between Albany and Binghamton, NY on Steiber Rd
entries.description: One lesbian on 30 acres between Albany and Binghamton, NY, with an old house, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping by a stream, woods and possible farmland; her college-age sons live there part-time. Lesbian couples have visited. Welcomes new members/residents, possibly girl children, boy children under 10 to visit, and leashed dogs; no hard drugs, guns or heavy drinking.
entries.raw_text: DEER SONG c/o Maggie Laird, RD Box 99, Stamford, NY 12167 (607)652-5057(weekends only). Located between Albany and Binghamton, NY on Steiber Rd. Lesbian couples have stayed here and love the peaceful quiet. 30 miles to a lesbian support group. For now, my two college age sons are part-time dwellers, also dogs and cats. One spare bedroom so Winter is not best for staying. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children (maybe), boy children under 10 to visit, dogs on leash. Please, no hard drugs, guns or heavy drinking. Bring your own groceries. Donations appreciated but not necessary. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 2 nonlesbians, 30 acres, old house, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space with stream, lots of woods, possible farmland, woman living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: rural route address (RD Box 99) taken as the land; listing also says 'on Steiber Rd'. Type: Private/Individual Land, one woman ('1 lesbian', 'woman living and working on the land'); welcome of new members is a checked item. num_residents 1: 'woman living and working on the land'; the 2 nonlesbians appear to be the 'two college age sons' who are 'part-time dwellers' (part-time family, noted not counted). Accepted: Lesbian women; Girl children '(maybe)'; Boy children conditional 'under 10 to visit'. Focus: Recovery/substance-free from 'Please, no hard drugs, guns or heavy drinking'. Phone 'weekends only'.

entries.description: Separatist women's land since 1978 (formerly Rowdybush) near Woodstock, NY: a 50-acre working homestead with animals, gardens, solar greenhouse and swimming places, offering short-term separatist healing space to lesbian and non-lesbian women. The Wise Woman Center runs herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives and apprenticeships. Four women live there; welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAUGHING ROCK FARM/WISE WOMAN CENTER c/o Susun Weed, 3136 Fishcreek, Saugerties, NY 12477 (near Woodstock). Laughing Rock Farm is safe space for womyn. Maintained as separatist land for 8 years (since '78), Laughing Rock (formerly Rowdybush) is a working homestead with goats, ducks, geese, chickens, cats, fruit, veg and herb gardens, lots of private (clothes off) playing and swimming places, solar greenhouse, and a trillion tons of rock. It is our belief that all womyn (lesbians or not) need separatist space for healing; we offer it, on short-term basis. The Wise Woman Center, offers herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: street address taken as the land. Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because the place is defined by what it offers visitors ('we offer it, on short-term basis') and by the Wise Woman Center's 'workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships'; four women do live there, so Intentional Community/Cooperative was also possible. num_residents 4 from '2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women; Girl children and Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women' and 'all womyn (lesbians or not)'. Focuses: Lesbian separatism from 'Maintained as separatist land' (separatism here means women-only, open to non-lesbians); Farming from 'working homestead' with livestock and gardens; Workshops/education from the workshops and apprenticeships; Spirituality/ritual from 'spirit healing workshops'. Formerly named Rowdybush.

entries.community_name: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE
entries.description: A permanent feminist peace vigil on 53 acres outside the Seneca Army Depot nuclear weapons storage site in NY; an open, changing community working collectively by non-violence and consensus with communal vegetarian meals, wheelchair-accessible permanent structures and chem-free spaces. Many lesbians and non-lesbian women; welcomes new members, girl and boy children and non-lesbian women for short and long stays.
entries.raw_text: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE 5440 Rt 96, Romulus, NY 14541 (607)869-5825. We are a permanent vigil for peace and justice outside the Seneca Army Depot, the largest nuclear weapons storage site in the world. We are an open, constantly changing, feminist community struggling to overcome oppression and militarism both outside our community and within it. We welcome all women who respect our commitment to non-violence and consensus process for short and long-term stays. Work is done collectively, and all meals are communal and vegetarian. All permanent structures are wheelchair accessible, and there are chem-free spaces on the land. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: many lesbians and nonlesbians, 53 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: route/street address (5440 Rt 96) taken as the land. Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative, calls itself a 'feminist community' with collective work and communal meals. num_residents blank: 'many lesbians and nonlesbians' gives no number. Accepted: Lesbian women; Non-lesbian women named ('nonlesbian women'); Girl and Boy children from 'girl & boy children'. Focus: Disabled women from 'All permanent structures are wheelchair accessible' stated as a feature of the place. 'chem-free spaces' noted but not coded as Recovery/substance-free (spaces, not a rule of the whole place). Peace/anti-militarism purpose noted (no matching focus).

entries.description: A community of 4 lesbians (down from 7) on 35 acres near Baltimore, MD, in transition and working on living together as a group. Has 5 buildings, conference center facilities, solar greenhouse, plumbing/electricity, camping, 25 acres of woods, limited farmland and long-organic gardens. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children and non-lesbian women; not into drugs.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-0280 (35 miles from Baltimore). We are presently 4 lesbians, down from 7 over the summer. We are in big transitions, and are hoping to focus our energies this winter to achieve some concrete goals. Right now it feels like everything is up in the air. Miscommunication is a common theme in our lives and we're struggling for ways to live harmoniously as a group instead of as separate individuals "tolerating" each other. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We're not into drugs. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 35 acres, 5 buildings, conference center facilities, solar greenhouse, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods (25 acres), limited farmland, a lot of gardens - 20 years organic, friendly neighbors, women working the land, an inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Land location: street address taken as the land; '35 miles from Baltimore' is a distance and left out of land_location_as_stated. Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative, calls itself a 'community' and a 'group' of 4 lesbians living there. num_residents 4 from 'We are presently 4 lesbians, down from 7 over the summer'. Accepted: Lesbian women; Girl children and Non-lesbian women from the welcome list. Focus: Recovery/substance-free from 'We're not into drugs'. Solar greenhouse and '20 years organic' gardens are list items, not coded as Environmentalism; conference center facilities not coded as Workshops. Listing says 'an inactive group with hopes to revive'.

entries.description: Two lesbian musicians on 20 acres in Unger, WV, finishing an owner-built passive-solar home begun in 1982. They sponsor women-only concerts every June and September as Rural Women's Productions and run a consulting and woodworking business. Welcomes non-lesbian women and men; no drugs, moderate alcohol, smoking restrictions. Unlimited camping space and woods.
entries.raw_text: GREENSTALK c/o Nan or Ruth, South Morgan Dr, Box 65, Berkeley Springs, WV 25411 (304)258-5079 (Unger, WV). In 1982, construction of an owner-built, passive-solar home began and is nearing completion. We're musicians and sponsor women-only concerts every June and Sept as Rural Women's Productions. We run a consulting and woodworking business. We welcome: nonlesbian women, males. No drugs, moderate alcohol, smoking restrictions, bring food to share. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, 1 house, 1 permanent structure, plumbing/electricity, unlimited camping space, woods, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: listing places the land in '(Unger, WV)', so land_city Unger; the mailing address is in Berkeley Springs, so the mailing street and zip were not copied to land_* as the land town differs. Type: Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'); concert guests do not change it. num_residents 2 from '2 lesbians' with 'women living on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women; Non-lesbian women named; Gay men and Non-gay men from 'males' with no orientation given. Focuses: Archives/cultural work from 'We're musicians and sponsor women-only concerts ... as Rural Women's Productions'; Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs' (alcohol allowed in moderation). Passive-solar home mentioned but not presented as a principle, so Environmentalism not coded.

entries.description: Fifty acres of hardwoods and pines with 3 fields and one finished house in rural Pittsboro, NC, about 35 miles from Raleigh and 20 from Chapel Hill. The owner wants other women to build houses and live on the land and is open to selling 5-10 acres. Listing continues on the next page.
entries.raw_text: HERLAND c/o Duffy Z Baum, PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340 (Located in rural Pittsboro, NC). The property is a mixture of hardwoods and pines with 3 fields and one finished house on 50 acres. I am interested in having other women build houses and live on the land. I am also open to selling 5-10 acres. There is a large, active lesbian political community about 35 miles away in Durham. Herland is about 35 miles from Raleigh and 20 miles from Chapel Hill. Unemployment in this area
